stacking.note: No hardware stacking on the datasheet. Arista SWAG (Switch Aggregation Group) can combine switches into one logical system over standard Ethernet links, but per-platform support is not published publicly

verifyNote: SWAG support is not on the datasheet and Arista's platform list is behind a login. If confirmed, set stacking.tech to SWAG and take the member limit and port usage from the platform documentation, not the general 48-switch figure

routing.summary: EOS Layer 3: static, OSPFv2/v3, IS-IS, BGP/MP-BGP, RIPv2, PIM, VRRP, VRF, BGP-EVPN VXLAN. OSPF, IS-IS, BGP and PIM need the Enhanced license; EVPN needs FLX-Lite

routeScale: 16K IPv4 / 8K IPv6 LPM routes, 64K IPv4 host routes (default forwarding mode 2); up to 144K IPv4 / 72K IPv6 LPM in mode 4

power.summary: Two hot-swap, field-replaceable PSU bays (four on the 2RU 96ZC2). 650W, 1050W or 2000W AC and 500W or 700W DC, model dependent. Three field-replaceable fans (N+1)

redundancy.detail: N+1: -F bundles ship one PSU, -2F bundles ship two; the second PSU adds PoE budget

licensing: Base EOS included. OSPF, IS-IS, BGP and PIM need the Enhanced (E) license; BGP-EVPN/VXLAN needs FLX-Lite (LIC-FIX-G1/G2/G3 by model license group). CloudVision management is a subscription
note: CCS-720XP-48Y6 and -24Y6 (end of sale Dec 31, 2026; replaced by CCS-720XPM-48TH-6SY and CCS-720DP-24S-M-S) and the 4GB CCS-720XP-96ZC2 (end of sale Mar 20, 2026; replaced by -M-S) are intentionally excluded
